page.layout: One page of text, single column; heading centred at top; dedicatory paragraph, then signature block centred below. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Dedicatio.
main_text.p: fructum, utpote vestrā fœcunda-tione partum, Vobis (Illustriss. ac Præp. Domini,) animo grato, ac submisso, non offerre; Fretus quam maximè, vestro in veros veritatis cultores favore, ac in me singulari benevolentia. Hafce igitur Institutiones ad V. D. aram suspendo, easque ut benignè accipiatis, & à malignis livoris morsibus tutam vindicetis, supplex rogo.

page.notes: Fragment at top of page begins mid-word "fructum"; the preceding words of the dedication are on the previous page. Faint show-through and a faint watermark/digitiser stamp at bottom right are not transcribed. Long s rendered as plain s; "s" in the source is long s.
